summary: Find Thevenin equivalent (Vth, Rth) at terminals a,b of a resistor-bridge circuit with Is and Vs sources, then analyze switching transient of a circuit with coupled inductors (L, M) and resistors: initial current, first-order ODE, ZIR+ZSR solution for I(t), impulse response Vab(t), and sinusoidal steady state via phasors.
